task_relevant_points: Foldseek performs fast structural search using a learned/structural alphabet prefilter and alignment stage.
Benchmark comparisons mention TM-align, CE, Dali, and precision-recall style sensitivity evaluations.
TM-score sorting/normalization is central for ranking structural hits.
US-align supports oligomeric structure alignment with chain-level and residue-level correspondences.
Reported outputs include TM-score, RMSD, coverage, and execution time.
Complex alignment requires explicit chain assignment plus rigid-body superposition.
TM-score is length-normalized and intended to reflect global topology better than RMSD.
TM-align combines dynamic programming with TM-score guided superposition search.
A TM-score threshold around 0.5 is historically associated with same-fold similarity in monomer settings.

required_outputs: residue-level aligned set for chosen mapping
rigid transform with rotation and translation
discussion of approximation relative to Foldseek-Multimer/US-align
limitations_identified: No direct Foldseek or US-align binary is currently verified in workspace.
Biopython unavailable; exact external-tool reproduction may not be possible without custom implementation.
